ROLES (most recent first; years in role computed as of 2026-10):
- Regional Sales Manager · Haulmark · 2024-03 – present (current role) · 2.6 yrs
  - Led 9 AEs; reported to the General Manager; grew channel partners 3 → 17 in ~18 months.
  - Northeast bookings ~$3.2M → ~$5.6M a year; 41 new carrier accounts; ~18% partner-sourced by 2025.
  - Remote onboarding for new carriers; time to first dispatch cut ~40%.
- Head of Revenue Operations · ledgerline · 2021-11 – 2024-03 · 2.3 yrs
  - Stood up a deal desk for 30+ sellers; average discount ~19% → ~12%.
  - Launched usage-based pricing for SMB lending: $2.4M net-new ARR in its first year (600+ merchant accounts).
  - Commissions into Salesforce, reports into Looker; month-end commission run ~6 days → 2.
  - Wrote the sales team's territory-planning model.
- Mid-Market Account Executive · Marlow Payroll · 2018-05 – 2021-11 · 3.5 yrs
  - President's Club 2019 and 2020 (124%, then 131% of annual quota).
- Inside Sales Representative · Keyward Security · 2016-08 – 2018-05 · 1.8 yrs
  - Free trials to paid plans, 12–15 new accounts/mo; signed Nakatomi, Ashgrove, Pemberton Mills.
TOTAL YEARS IN SALES ROLES: 10.2 (titles counted: Regional Sales Manager; Head of Revenue Operations; Mid-Market Account Executive; Inside Sales Representative)
CAREER SPAN: 10.2 yrs since the earliest role
EDUCATION: B.S. · Lakeside State University · 2008 – 2012
SKILL DEPTH: Salesforce: hands-on, Gong: hands-on, MEDDIC: taught it to the AE team, Channel Partnerships: b_052
NEVER CLAIM (hard constraint): titles ['VP', 'Vice President', 'SVP', 'CRO', 'Chief Revenue Officer', 'Head of Sales', 'Director of Sales', 'General Manager'], tools [], phrases ['treasury management sales']
